title: Stillmere, the village frozen in time
story_basis: docs/full-story.md section9: Stillmere preserved echo beneath dark sky of motionless stars, across a river; golden windows, smoke that never disperses, suspended leaves; enormous central tree.
Frozen villagers and repeating actions are separate character assets; temporal stillness is not literal snow/ice. Building and bridge designs below are environmental proposals.
review_notes: Environment proposal/prototype; no production approval or runtime integration inferred.
Interactive art states below are production interpretations, not newly established story mechanics.

Eight requested source types saved and visually reviewed as generated prototypes; no final production approval. Terrain module edge matching and collision setup, prop pivots and FX timing remain cleanup work.

deliverables.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Lanterns Underroot hand-painted illustrated 2D side-scrolling platformer asset. Input images ART-001/002/006 are style, palette, material and layer-separation references ONLY; ignore their text, logos, characters, guide panels and layouts. Match rich painterly wood/stone/foliage, selective crisp silhouettes, restrained brush texture, warm amber light against forest greens and cool blue-teal shadows. Strict SIDE-ON game camera, no isometric view or forced vanishing-point perspective on usable surfaces. No player, NPC, enemy, UI, logo, watermark, labels or text. Deliver one named usable asset type only; never a concept board or flattened multi-layer scene posing as separate game layers. Stillmere, the village frozen in time: preserved woodland village memory beneath motionless starry dark sky, river crossing, warm golden windows, arrested smoke and leaves, immense central tree. Temporal freeze, NOT ice or winter. Primary request: ONE 1536x1024 composed side-on environment LIGHTING STUDY of Stillmere, the village frozen in time. Motionless deep blue night contrasted with cozy golden windows; inviting yet unnaturally still, not horror/gore, icy blue or snowy winter. Original path reveal light is subtle warm amber. Show one coherent representative location view without characters; no panels, guide text, logos or atlas. It may combine environment layers solely to demonstrate intended light/depth. This is explicitly an art reference, NOT a runtime layer, terrain atlas, flattened substitute for the other seven deliverables, or production-ready level.
review_notes: Recovered completed generation after interruption; visual review follows. Reference only, not runtime layer.
Source visually reviewed; prototype only, final production approval pending.
